deliverables: Enabling onchain payments and card infrastructure
Open-source on-chain payments infrastructure including smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Stablecoin-backed banking rails and compliance architecture
Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC and PSSC smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and a 115,385 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex addresses a claimed gap in Cardano by providing infrastructure for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity.

The proposed solution will provide full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure for onchain settlement through smart contracts connected to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is asserted to have more than 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Funds will be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, external oversight entities, and on-chain dashboard tracking.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, including reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex payments infrastructure initiative submitted by Intersect, with the main claimed benefits being open-source Cardano payment rails, Visa card integration, wallet and stablecoin/banking connectivity, and adoption from Wirex's existing payments business; governance support, NCL compliance, and smart-contract fund administration are described with references and addresses, while several major adoption and capability claims are largely proposer assertions.
